title: How to Ride China's Subway — No Ticket Needed | China Travel Expert
description:
Landing in China and dreading the subway? Don't buy a ticket — you won't need one.

In 2026 the standard way tourists ride the metro is a transit QR code inside Alipay or WeChat. Open the app, tap the transit / 乘车码 feature, pick your city, and it generates a QR you scan at the gate to enter and again to exit — the distance-based fare is deducted automatically. Most city-center rides cost just 3–5 yuan (about 50–70 US cents), stations have English signage, and one QR works across 200+ Chinese cities. No app? Buy a single-journey token from the platform machine, or a cash transit card as backup.

🧭 Expert Tip: Set up the transit QR before you fly — it needs a one-time passport real-name verification that's far easier on home wifi than at a crowded gate.

在中国坐地铁不用买票——手机乘车码进出站，自动按里程扣费。
